name: SDXL documentary photo
description: SDXL base text-to-image tuned for documentary / phone-photo realism: 1216×832, dpmpp_2m karras, 25 steps, CFG 6.5. Briefs with lighting "dark" (an outage) start from a dark latent at denoise 0.92 with a dark-ceiling area prompt over the top 40%. Briefs with lighting "screens-off" (blank screens, power on) add unlit-ceiling area prompts over the top 40% and repaint lit blue or amber signs found in the top 45% as dark, unlit boards (denoise 0.55). Needs sd_xl_base_1.0.safetensors in models/checkpoints.

styles.phone: candid smartphone photo, handheld, slightly tilted framing, natural available light, mild motion blur, smartphone camera noise, unedited, everyday realism
styles.press: news agency photojournalism, telephoto lens, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on subject, natural colors, editorial documentary style
styles.cctv: security camera still frame, high elevated wide angle view, slight fisheye distortion, low resolution, washed out colors, grainy, harsh fluorescent lighting
styles.screen: photo of a computer monitor taken with a phone, visible screen pixels and moire, slight glare, dim office background
styles.portrait: documentary portrait photograph, 85mm lens, natural window light, neutral background, realistic skin texture
